summary: Verified DynoPay paid-link resurrection bug fix in cryptoCheckout.ts getData(). Ran 4 pytest cases against POST /api/pay/getData and 2 frontend E2E page loads. All 5 review-request items pass.

test_results.1_paid_link_818c_getData: PASS - payment_completed=true, amount=800 USD, paid 0.42472539 ETH, paid_at set, description contains 'Ireland...3CX'
test_results.2_paid_link_89a0_getData: PASS - payment_completed=true, amount=75 USD, paid 0.00120154 BTC
test_results.3_paid_link_818c_frontend: PASS - Green 'Payment successful' card rendered with '0.42472539 ETH (≈ 800.00 USD) paid', 'Paid 1 hour ago • Aug 13, 2026' chip, and completed ORDER→PAYMENT→DONE stepper. NO QR/currency form shown.
test_results.4_active_link_c86e_regression: PASS - getData returns amount=10 EUR, available_currencies list present, token present, no payment_completed flag. Frontend renders normal checkout: 'Pay hostbay', REFERENCE · INV-2026-171, NETWORK/CURRENCY selectors (Bitcoin/BTC), QR code, WAITING banner.

seed_data_creation: None - read-only testing on live production DB as instructed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live production DB - use READ-ONLY approach. Paid refs 818c... and 89a0... are permanent test fixtures. Active ref c86e... is a €10 test link. Bug fix in backend/controller/payment/cryptoCheckout.ts getData() (hasUsableSession guard + DB fallback for expired sessions on settled links) is working correctly.
rca of the issue: Redis checkout session was soft-deleted ~30min after settlement. Backend getData wrote back language BEFORE the empty-session guard, resurrecting expired keys as bare {language} shells that passed the guard with no link_id, so DB paid-status gate never fired. Fix: (1) hasUsableSession requires real checkout fields, (2) language persisted only on usable sessions, (3) session-missing → DB fallback lookup by payment_link ref returns {payment_completed:true, ...} for settled links or 404. Verified via 4 pytest cases + 2 frontend renders.
